digest.component_or_area: config sources and resolvers module structure
propositions: src/rebar/_config_sources.py exceeds the near-cap warning band (791 LOC) and must be split to prevent CI breakage from future config changes
Raw-input resolution layer (lines 31-361) and RP-04 below-seam owned resolvers (lines 364-791) are separated by existing in-file concern boundaries and should be moved to distinct modules

_snapshot_table is the only resolver that reaches back into raw-input functions (user_config_path, _read_toml_table, _discover_project_config) and requires lazy in-body module import to preserve late binding for monkeypatch regression tests
All 29 moved names (24 entry points + 4 helpers + 1 constant) must remain re-exported from _config_sources.py to maintain unchanged import surface for rebar._config_sources and rebar.config
The new _config_resolvers.py module must be added to check_config_ownership.py composition root whitelist and docs/env-vars.md must be regenerated to reflect relocated env-name citations
